items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; candidate_exclusion_reason excluded_intervention_type; aldesleukin = part of the excluded cell therapy (not a candidate)
items.reason: D30-R4: IL-2 given to support a cell therapy is part of the excluded therapy. Aldesleukin is given 'beginning within 24 hours of cell infusion' to every patient in the single arm. It has no arm or outcome of its own, so the exception does not apply.

Same as above. The 'high- or low-dose aldesleukin' wording does not make IL-2 the subject of investigation; the primary outcome is response to the TCR-transposed PBL. Cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are lymphodepleting conditioning (manual R6, supportive).

note: Under D30-R4 the aldesleukin role (coder A soc_backbone, coder B supportive; a priority-3 item) is best recorded as excluded_intervention_type (part of the excluded therapy). Glioblastoma is named in inclusion as Cohort 4.
